name: Bombardier CRJ200 LR
summary: Valcon Air's first aircraft, delivered to Wilson Airport, Nairobi. A regional jet built for fast, comfortable flights on short and medium routes.
features: Cabin about 12.4 m long, 2.5 m wide and 1.85 m high
Seating up to 50 in the standard layout; cabin layout for 5Y-VAL to be confirmed

name: Fokker 50
summary: Valcon Air's second aircraft, a twin-turboprop Fokker 50 based at Wilson Airport, Nairobi. It flies in a plain white livery for now.
features: Registration 7Q-SAS; seating and cabin layout to be confirmed

hero.alt: Valcon Air's Fokker 50 touching down at Wilson Airport, Nairobi.
